definition: Rasa = aesthetic relish (camatkāra) — the emotional flavor that a literary or artistic work evokes in a sensitive reader (sahṛdaya). In the literal sense: taste/relish (rasayati = makes tasteable). In the aesthetic sense: the relishable state of elemental human emotions (bhāvas) transformed into something universal (sādhāraṇīkaraṇa). Rasa has no equivalent in any other language.

sources.claim: rasa as abhivyakti (manifestation) in the sahṛdaya's heart through dhvani (suggestion)

translations.note: 'Aesthetic relish' is the closest; 'juice' and 'essence' are etymological; 'taste' is the literal sense. No English word fully captures rasa.
